subject.title: Redesign publish plugin & skill empty states

question: Should new skill/plugin publishing hide metadata until files are selected, or should the pre-upload metadata form remain available while the empty state is polished?
rationale: The branch changes a user-visible publish workflow and the existing automation contract, so the permanent UX contract needs maintainer intent before an automated repair can choose a direction.

options.title: Adopt upload-first after repairs
options.body: Keep the progressive-disclosure direction, but require local-auth helper/test updates and real branch screenshots before merge.

options.title: Preserve the pre-upload form
options.body: Ask for narrower copy/layout polish that keeps metadata, rights, and source controls present before file selection.

options.title: Pause the workflow redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide whether hiding pre-upload metadata is desirable for publishing.

recommendation.title: Adopt upload-first after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the progressive-disclosure direction, but require local-auth helper/test updates and real branch screenshots before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is most directly tied to the current publish workflow and local-auth helper contract in recent merged history.
